description:
Found by s527a's §31 probe (2026-10-24).  With the vendored PPI `sub _ { ... }` is now a Statement::Sub named `_` (group H; t/op/filetest.t:161-162 moved DROP -> OK in the gate-SET scan and both rows print 1 as perl does).  But a CALL of that sub is still dropped:

    sub _ { "x" } print _(), "y\n";      # perl: xy
    PCL: statement dropped ... print _(), "\n"; -- Bug. Fell through. Missing case: ['Token::Magic<_>', ...]

PPI (master and branch alike) lexes the `_` of `_()` as Token::Magic, the stat filehandle -- it is the stat filehandle everywhere but after `sub`, and a `_` followed directly by `(` is a call in perl (`-f _` never takes parens).  Two possible fixes: (a) on the PPI branch, `_` followed by `(` is a Word (Token/Word.pm __underscore_class, the helper group H added: one more condition); (b) at PCL's lowering, a Magic `_` followed by a List is a call to `main::_`.  (a) is the right layer (a token class) and is a new row for s527b's tokenizer batch.  Reproducer: scratch/s527a/residual/filetest-sub_.pl in the s527a worktree.
subject: A call of a sub named _ (`_()`) is still dropped: PPI lexes the _ before ( as the stat filehandle (s527a Â§31 probe; fix on the PPI branch)
